caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: “How to Create an ANIMATED INFOGRAPHIC” makes both operative words into large lavender rough-display tags.
visual_anatomy.layout: A nine-tile catalog presents a different animated technique in every equally sized cell, with a miniature demonstration and method note.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → scan nine numbered tiles left-to-right and top-to-bottom → use each miniature as the retrieval cue.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large headline, hand-rendered emphasis labels, small section headers, and compact process notes.
visual_anatomy.colour: Each tile has a distinct pastel fill that helps separation but does not encode a data variable.
visual_anatomy.surface: Flat colored tile fields, dark rules, simple illustrated objects, pills, and fine shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Nine equal technique cards, each containing a miniature motion specimen plus a concise how-to note.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: the catalog is designed for browsing and later retrieval rather than a single linear argument.

motion.observed_state_change: Across sampled frames, individual miniatures visibly demonstrate path tracing, orbital movement, checkbox completion, appearing pills, selector travel, exploding circles, and text movement.
motion.motion_job: Teach animation by showing each micro-mechanism in the exact spatial context it would affect.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Select a motion technique based on the visual change it makes, not an abstract label alone.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Pair a named technique with a tiny observable state change and a concise implementation note.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when motion adds explanatory value; an animation catalog is not a reason to animate otherwise static content.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the nine-technique catalog, tile contents, method labels, color palette, rough title tags, or source animation examples.

claim_boundary.note: This is a craft reference rather than a performance study. It does not establish that any specific animation improves LinkedIn results.
